wiki_article:
**Measurement Stack Workplan** (EA-SEMSTACK-WORKPLAN-01) is a live tracking document carrying 59 numbered items across deposits, captures, the Public Self-Audit Module, both measurement surfaces, experiments, lexicon gaps, terminology, distribution, items held deliberately, items refused with reasons, and items carried unresolved from earlier sessions.

It names one blocker on which everything downstream depends: **the full-stack computation of a single transcript as a complete measurement object** — raw evidence through attribution atoms, PER-M/C/D, PER, Ω, α_T, Π_d, ρ_T, DSL span classes, Β, classification and control. All four Assembly reviews arrived at this independently.

Written because a single day produced seven documents, four reviews and roughly forty actionable ideas, and unrecorded ideas do not survive contact with the next session. Items close by deposit or by capture, never by assertion.
